correctness.rationale: Planar projected orthotope zonotope gives A=Σ_{i<j}ai aj|pij| and P=2Σak rk. Haar invariance yields shared-index moment E|pij| rk=1/4 and disjoint-index π/16 (via oriented Gr+(2,4)≅S²×S² independent unit vectors). Summing yields the mixed moment, and subtracting EA=e2/3 and EP=4e1/3 yields the covariance. The exact identity e1e2−6e3=1/2Σ_{i<j<k}[ai(aj−ak)^2+aj(ai−ak)^2+ak(ai−aj)^2] enforces sharp equality at cubes. Independently proved the SOS identity by SymPy expansion and computed the exact d=4 specialization of the separate all-dimensional theorem.
